title: New: Tours that say what changed, and a moment when you finish
summary: Every tour now names what changed in plain words, and finishing a tour or reaching a milestone shows a small moment to mark it.

payload.title: Every tour says what changed
payload.body: Each tour title now names the change itself, so you can tell at a glance which ones you want to take. You will find them all in Tours.

payload.title: A small moment when you finish
payload.body: Finish this tour and watch the bottom of your screen. You will see another when your first action is done, and again at each milestone after that.

payload.title: A few are hidden
payload.body: Some moments only show up when you go looking for them. Try typing trillion x anywhere in Trillion.
